scales-major-minor.title: Turn C major into C natural minor
scales-major-minor.instruction: Play the scale once. On the notes line, change E4 to Eb4, A4 to Ab4, and B4 to Bb4. Play again; Undo restores the major scale.
scales-major-minor.listenFor: The tonic and rhythm stay the same. Listen to the changed gaps at the third, sixth, and seventh notes.

keys-tonic.instruction: Listen to the melody returning to C. Change the first E4 on the notes line to Eb4, then play again. Undo returns to the original.
keys-tonic.listenFor: One outside note changes the phrase without automatically making another note the tonic. Notice whether C still feels settled.

diatonic-chords.title: Move a progression to another key
diatonic-chords.instruction: Play C–G–Am–F. Add transpose: 2 below the notes line and apply the change. Remove that line to return.
diatonic-chords.listenFor: Every chord moves up two semitones: D–A–Bm–G. The I–V–vi–IV relationship and chord qualities stay the same.

progressions-cadences.instruction: In the notes line, change only the last chord [C4,E4,G4] to [A3,C4,E4]. Apply, then Undo to compare the two endings.
progressions-cadences.listenFor: The original ends Dm–G–C. The edit ends Dm–G–Am: the G chord reaches a different destination.

modes-and-small-scales.title: Change A natural minor into A Dorian
modes-and-small-scales.instruction: Play the melody, then change its F4 to F#4. Keep the A bass and all other notes unchanged. Undo restores natural minor.
modes-and-small-scales.listenFor: A remains the intended center. Raising the sixth degree changes A natural minor into A Dorian.

outside-the-key.title: Borrow F minor in C major
outside-the-key.instruction: In the second chord, change A3 to Ab3. Play again, then Undo to compare. The first F-major chord stays unchanged.
outside-the-key.listenFor: The progression becomes F–Fm–C. Follow A moving down to Ab and then G while the last chord still settles on C.
